name: Age of Magic
summary:
Enter Arrat, a shattered magical world where darkness spreads, demon legions threaten civilization, and an ancient prophecy foretells the arrival of a True Mage destined to find the Dark Tower.

Collect and upgrade 200+ unique heroes, including Witches, Demons, Elves, Knights, Forest Spirits, and Spawn of Chaos. Build squads of five heroes, master powerful synergies, and develop winning strategies. Explore two story-driven campaigns, compete in PvP Arena battles and Tournaments, join Clans for epic Raids and Clan Battles, and take on challenging dungeons and special events.
